name: Supernova BYTU field (Hubble)
blurb: A deep field toward the distant Type Ia supernova BYTU, seen by Hubble.
label: supernovabytufield-hubble
story: Hubble looked here for a faint, distant Type Ia supernova found by Subaru's Hyper Suprime-Cam search. The SUSHI program paired Subaru light curves with Hubble images of supernovae like this one to sharpen measurements of dark energy.

claims.text: BYTU is a Type Ia supernova target of Hubble program 15363 (SUSHI)
The supernovae were discovered by the Subaru Strategic Program's rolling search with Hyper Suprime-Cam, reaching high redshift
SUSHI combines the HSC light curve with Hubble observations to improve the dark energy figure of merit
